source.name: NSS Sports, 'Kappa is the new Genoa technical supplier'
source.quote: Genoa announces the start of a new partnership with Kappa, twenty-one years after the last time
source.note: Announced 14 June 2019, for the 2019/20 kits; Kappa replaced Lotto. Kappa is still Genoa's 'Technical Sponsor' on the club's partner page in 2026/27, and made the 2026/27 KOMBAT™ home kit. Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers.

note: Kit-supply partnership running since 2019/20 and through 2026/27. No reported deal value found.
